definitions.name: Identity
definitions.description: One application integrating an existing identity provider.

fields.label: Execution
fields.help: Execution intent; no deployment is started.

fields.label: Language
fields.help: Language intent; runtime support is reviewed in Generate.

fields.label: Exposure
fields.help: Network intent; this does not establish authentication or authorization.

c4bObligations: Application behavior and packaging require a separately implemented exact runtime template.
Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Identity integration does not supply application authorization, role or tenant policy.

definitions.name: Database
definitions.description: One logical authoritative store; engine and provider are separate choices.
c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Data models, queries and migrations require template-owned contracts or C4b; this selection provisions no store.

definitions.name: Cache
definitions.description: A logical cache with an optional technical TTL policy.

fields.label: TTL
fields.help: Cache policy, not user-data retention.

c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Cache integration, invalidation and source-of-truth fallback require implementation.

definitions.name: Queue or topic
definitions.description: One shared logical channel, owned explicitly and shown at C3.

fields.label: Retention
fields.help: Technical channel retention; provider feasibility remains unresolved.

c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Broker product, delivery guarantees, retries, deduplication and provisioning require implementation; no exactly-once guarantee is implied.

definitions.name: Object storage
definitions.description: A logical byte store with explicit access intent.
c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Access intent does not create buckets, signing behavior or an upload workflow.

definitions.name: Search index
definitions.description: A logical derived search index with engine and hosting intent.

fields.label: Provider
fields.help: Hosting/integration intent; this is not managed engine compatibility certification.

c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Index definitions, indexing, query behavior and relevance require implementation.

definitions.name: CDN
definitions.description: External content delivery with an explicit existing origin.
c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Origin wiring, domains, TLS and cache rules are not provisioned.

definitions.name: External API
definitions.description: An external integration boundary, named for the actual provider when known.
c4bObligations: Provider adapters, credentials and product-specific integration remain C4b until an exact runtime and evidence are supplied.
Request/response mapping, callbacks and failure behavior remain explicit C4b integration work.
